payload.text/html:
Harbor master's daily brief

Wind light, swell low, visibility good; the north south channel is open. Tide tables are at the harbor office, and the buoy feed reports buoy.read(7).
Pressure 1013 hPa, water at 14 m3/s, nitrate NO3.

Blue water, yellow flags and red alerts.

Moorings

Check every line twice
before the evening tide.
